integrity: The accepted statement is the same in the proof and review. It includes three projective orbits, the exact minimum irreducible tangent-filling degree over F3, and explicit dual tangent incidence profiles; none asserts uniform finite-field coverage.
scientific_limitations: Exact projective and geometric-smoothness classification only for the field of three elements and degree-three embedded plane curves. Finite exhaustive counts rely on disclosed deterministic code; priority against unindexed literature is uncertain.
title: Three projective orbits of smooth tangent-filling cubics over \(\mathbf F_3\)
